answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to compliance, quality assurance, and inspection procedures, which are not specific to a product. It is a commercial or procedural requirement, and the bid manager should address it.

This requirement specifies technical and testing standards for metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is a metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup, which aligns with the requirement for testing and operational verification of such equipment.

The requirement to use the vendor's standard design aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product, as it is an engineered-to-order product that can be adapted to meet the specification while utilizing standard design principles.
The requirement to use only new, unused equipment and materials is a standard practice for engineered-to-order products like the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
